t: Din erub [be]yom tob shechal beereb shabbat vedin ben hashshemashot leerub
s: Din erub [be]yom tob shechal beereb shabbat vedin ben hashshemashot leerub ubo g' seipim: en meorbin erube chatzerot veshittupe meboot beyom tob shechal lihyot beereb shabbat, mippene shennireh kimtaqqen dabar. Veim chalu b' yamim tobim beyom h' ubeyom v', veshakach velo ereb meereb yom tob — yeareb beyom tob al tenay, sheyyomar beyom tob a': im hayyom chol — yehe zeh erub, veim hayyom qodesh — en bidbaray kelum. Ulemachar yomar: im hayyom qodesh — hare erabti etmol, veim hayyom chol — yehe zeh erub. Veetza toba sheyyeareb lemachar bepat sheereb bah etmol, sheim yeareb bepat acheret — yeaser leekol shettehen qodem shechoshka lel shabbat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beb' yamim tobim shel galuyyot. Abal beb' yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana eno yakol leareb al tenay, mippene shehem keyom echad arok, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"r:

Echad erube chatzerot veechad shittupe meboot meorbim otam ben hashshemashot, mittaam shennitbaer besimman rs"a. Vaapillu im kebar qibbel alayv tosepet shabbat. Veyesh oserin im qibbel alayv tosepet shabbat (vehaiqqar kisbara harishona beqabbalat tosepet shabbat bilbad. Abal im hitpallel tepillat arbit shel shabbat — hare qibbel alayv shabbat atzmah, kevan shehitpallel tepillat lel shabbat, veneesar bekol hashshebutim kemo beshabbat atzmah, lebad mimmah shennaaseh al yede acher, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a veras"g. Vaapillu im hu lo hitpallel, im rob hatztzibbur hitpalelu — hammiut nimshakim acharehem beal korchan. Velo mishsheggameru hattepilla, ella apillu mishshehitchilu otah, dehaynu aniyyat "bareku", kemo shennitbaer sham):

Haerub eno tzarik lihyot qayyam ella ben hashshemashot, veyakol leoklo keshevvadday chasheka (shekkevan shenniqbea dirato bimqom erub beben hashshemashot, shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat — shub enah nipqaat mishsham kol hashshabbat, ap al pi shennotel mishsham erubo). Veyesh libtzoa alayv beshabbat shacharit (o bisuddat hallayla im soed mishshechasheka vadday), dehoil venaaset bo mitzva achat — yesh laasot bo gam ken mitzva acheret. Vaapillu neekal erubo beben hashshemashot — qana erub (ubediabad), ki ben hashshemashot hu sepeq layla, veshemma niknas kebar techillat hashshabbat, usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Vaapillu ereb lishnayim, leechad ereb mibbeod yom veneekal erubo ben hashshemashot, uleechad ereb ben hashshemashot venishar erubo qayyam ad shechasheka — shenehem qanu erub, shelleoto shenneekal erubo ben hashshemashot anu choshebin shebben hashshemashot hu layla, uleoto sheereb lo ben hashshemashot anu choshebin shebben hashshemashot hu yom, sheen meorbin mishshettechshak. Veap al pi sheereb lishnehem beben hashshemashot echad, vahare hen b' qullot hassoterot zo et zo — en bekak kelum, kevan shehem lishne bene adam. Abal im ereb leechad ben hashshemashot veneekal haerub ben hashshemashot — lo qana erub, veen meqillin kol kak lomar shebberega sheereb haya adayin yom, ukeshenneekal haya kebar layla ukebar qana erub:
